Build the 33 CIE official spines from parsed/cie-* via the pinned adapter; validate topics/subsections/spec_points counts against the parsed trees; --check green.

The big build: content-maps for 44 slugs (notes ride their existing 8,651 spec_point_links; flashcards attach via the same links; the 1,118 EQ topics need the topic→spec-point mapping — notes-links + parsed-spec section numbering make it tractable, but this is the main work item), then build_official_content.py per slug → 44 rekeyed content bundles.

Add the 44 rows (status 'full', no coreBridge), commit the bundles, CI hub build green; courses go live with notes/flashcards/exam-questions surfaces rendered from the committed corpus bundles — the interactive/DB-independent surfaces light up here.

Per CIE spec: seed-bundle-curriculum; per slug: ingest-bundle-questions dry-run (rollback proof) → COW-proof → prod apply under the ADR-026 evidence-safe replace; 40 real banks become SME-ingestable (19,095 questions / 25,654 parts).
